summary: Jina AI gives every new API key 10M free tokens usable across the Search Foundation APIs — embeddings, reranker, reader, classifier, and related endpoints. Free-tier rate limits are 500 RPM, 1M TPM, and 5 concurrent requests; once the token grant is consumed, additional tokens are purchased on the key. No credit card needed for the signup grant.
claim_steps: Sign up at jina.ai and get your API key from jina.ai/api-dashboard/key-manager — new keys auto-receive 10M free tokens.
Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer jina_<key>' against api.jina.ai endpoints (embeddings, rerank, reader via r.jina.ai, etc.).
When free tokens run out, buy more on the key's 'Buy tokens' tab — the free grant is one-time.
